meta_description:
1,107 likes, 157 comments - cosmoindia on October 29, 2026: "Our digital cover star Kubbra Sait (@kubbrasait) has no interest in being a ‘good girl’. But like she promised on a recent Instagram post—a carousel of photos of her dressed in a blush pink sari, with flowers in her hair—she can look like one because ‘that’s called good acting’.

In her interview, the actor and author talks about stereotypes, skills, finding love, climbing mountains and seeking an anchor in self-discovery. Read the full story at the link in bio.

Editor: Snigdha Ahuja (@snigdha.ahuja)
